review.note: Approved. tsc 0 (Node 22.23.3). Read TableContextMenu.tsx, the E3 hunks of Writer.tsx (contextmenu handler gated on cellAround + posAtCoords, ContextMenu/Shift+F10 at coordsAtPos, menu render), the .table-menu-anchor / .table-context-menu CSS and the spec. Checklist: R1/F2 PASS (popover.css: items are bold on hover/focus-visible/highlighted, no grey fill; square corners, border-radius 0), R6 PASS (overscroll contain), R7 PASS, F4 PASS (items are buttons via PopoverItem, role menuitem), F3 PASS (menu labelled Table actions). Dark screenshot shows all six items, danger item red, readable. Notes only: (1) table-menu-light.png was captured mid-morph (bottom clipped, Delete table not visible), so the light render is unconfirmed by that file; test should wait for the morph before screenshot. (2) Only Delete table is asserted to change the table; the other five are stock tiptap commands wired identically to the panel, not individually asserted. (3) Native WebKit not run; spell suggestions hidden in cells as expected. Did not rerun Playwright; relied on author evidence (3/3 + motion 7/7, fail-first shown) plus static review.
